name: Transparent Illustration via Voxelization
definition: A technique for transparent illustration of complex deformable geometric models in volumetric scenes by storing multivalued data (normals, texture coordinates, material IDs) in the worksheet.
summary: Transparent Illustration via Voxelization renders complex deformable models semi-transparently by storing multivalued data in a voxel worksheet and integrating it into a slicing-based volume rendering pipeline.
